tasks.name: Sanity gate: alpha_0
tasks.description: Run the k=0 shard at seed 42 and read the control-arm EMR BEFORE anything else. RESULT: alpha_0 = 0.0000 on n=50. Prediction held.
tasks.prediction: alpha_0 is not detectably above 0 — run2's own gpt2 fixed-probe EMR was 0.0.
tasks.falsification: alpha_0's CI excludes 0, meaning exact_match fires spuriously. BLOCKS the study.

tasks.name: Cost at both grid extremes
tasks.description: Measure per-attack cost at BOTH grid extremes. Uses a separate run_id (e3a_cost) at PII_CAP_SWEEP_N=3, so k=64 costs ~0.17h on L4 instead of 1.43h and the probe never mixes into the evidence. Mid-grid alone cannot reveal the O(k) candidate-construction term. RESULT: per-attack 25.6s (k=1) / 31.0s (k=20) / 80.8s (k=64) on L4. The predicted O(k) blowup did NOT materialise -- k=64 measured 1.06x the linear model. The real omission was a ~10.5s k-independent fixed cost, making k=1 2.25x the model. Errors nearly cancel: main sweep projects to 15.1 A100-h against 16.4 estimated and 24 approved. Early stopping confirmed as the cause of k=20's low wallclock: steps_run is 200 at k=1 (no hits) but ~75 at k=20 and 55-77 at k=64.
tasks.prediction: k=64 costs materially more than the linear-in-(k+T) model predicts; k=1 evaluates 256 candidates, not 512.
tasks.falsification: Extrapolated total exceeds the approved 24 A100-h — re-scope rather than proceed.

Prediction was |D|=25 all tiers present and |C| in 15-25 -- held. E17 matches across all six TARGET_FORMATS fields (600 pairs), which is why the matched set is not thin.
